scope: Static review only; no fixture, model, native or phone execution.
findings: The fixture selects the open action and exact allowed text alias from the current frozen decoder schema; it does not generate a native call ID.
The original fixture response, saved named model action, deterministic mapping, mapped decision and actual native call are tied by request ID, alias, call ID and original/canonical byte hashes.
The original counter effect, receipt, action ledger, cleanup, joined-worker, slot and physical-follow-up boundaries are retained.
After the internal 90-second alarm is observed, no subsequent case is started; incomplete case sets cannot be marked PASS.
The outer 105-second subprocess wait and owned-child cleanup remain the enclosing boundedness mechanism. The internal alarm alone is not claimed as a complete process-group timeout.
